meta.description: Turkiye NPK recommendations for 15 crops (19 records; wheat/barley/sunflower split rainfed/irrigated) — user-supplied data (2026-10-13) with TAGEM, GAP, Trakya, Nazilli, Seker Enstitusu, BATEM sources. All values per hectare, no conversion.

records.applicationMethod: Full P and K + 1/3 N applied at sowing (taban gubresi: 20-20-0 or DAP). Remaining 2/3 N top-dressed in spring (ust gubreleme) at tillering and jointing stages.
records.applicationTiming: Taban gubresi at sowing; ust gubreleme at tillering and jointing (spring).
records.notes: N 60-80 kg/ha; P2O5 40-55 kg/ha; K2O 20-30 kg/ha. Rainfed bread wheat (kuru).
records.source_org: TAGEM (Tarımsal Araştırmalar ve Politikalar Genel Müdürlüğü)
records.source_org_2: TTAE Ankara (Soil, Fertilizer and Water Resources Central Research Institute)

records.applicationMethod: Full P and K + 1/3 N applied at sowing (taban gubresi: 20-20-0 or DAP). Remaining 2/3 N top-dressed in spring (ust gubreleme) at tillering and jointing stages.
records.applicationTiming: Taban gubresi at sowing; ust gubreleme at tillering and jointing (spring).
records.notes: N 140-180 kg/ha; P2O5 60-80 kg/ha; K2O 40-60 kg/ha. Irrigated bread wheat (sulu).
records.source_org: TAGEM (Tarımsal Araştırmalar ve Politikalar Genel Müdürlüğü)
records.source_org_2: TTAE Ankara (Soil, Fertilizer and Water Resources Central Research Institute)

records.applicationMethod: Taban gubresi (basal) applied at sowing. Ust gubreleme (urea / ammonium nitrate) top-dressed at end of winter.
records.applicationTiming: Basal at sowing; top-dress at end of winter.
records.notes: N 50-70 kg/ha; P2O5 35-50 kg/ha; K2O 20-30 kg/ha. Rainfed barley (arpa).
records.source_org: TAGEM (Tarımsal Araştırmalar ve Politikalar Genel Müdürlüğü)

records.applicationMethod: Taban gubresi (basal) applied at sowing. Ust gubreleme (urea / ammonium nitrate) top-dressed at end of winter.
records.applicationTiming: Basal at sowing; top-dress at end of winter.
records.notes: N 90-120 kg/ha; P2O5 45-60 kg/ha; K2O 30-45 kg/ha. Irrigated barley (arpa).
records.source_org: TAGEM (Tarımsal Araştırmalar ve Politikalar Genel Müdürlüğü)

records.applicationMethod: 1/3 N + all P and K banded at sowing. Remaining 2/3 N split at 6-8 leaf stage and tasseling stage.
records.applicationTiming: Basal band at sowing; N splits at 6-8 leaf and tasseling.
records.notes: N 200-250 kg/ha; P2O5 70-100 kg/ha; K2O 60-100 kg/ha. 1st and 2nd crop irrigated maize (mısır).
records.source_org: GAP International Agricultural Research and Training Center, Diyarbakır

records.applicationMethod: Basal at planting. Top-dressed N applied before inter-row cultivation (capa).
records.applicationTiming: Basal at planting; top-dress before inter-row cultivation.
records.notes: N 50-70 kg/ha; P2O5 40-55 kg/ha; K2O 25-40 kg/ha. Rainfed sunflower (aycicegi), Trakya region.

records.applicationMethod: Basal at planting. Top-dressed N applied before inter-row cultivation (capa).
records.applicationTiming: Basal at planting; top-dress before inter-row cultivation.
records.notes: N 90-120 kg/ha; P2O5 55-75 kg/ha; K2O 40-60 kg/ha. Irrigated sunflower (aycicegi), Trakya region.

records.applicationMethod: 1/3 N + all P and K applied as basal. Remaining 2/3 N split at first irrigation and flowering, via furrow or drip fertigation.
records.applicationTiming: Basal at planting; N splits at first irrigation and flowering.
records.notes: N 140-180 kg/ha; P2O5 60-85 kg/ha; K2O 50-80 kg/ha. Irrigated cotton (pamuk), Cukurova and GAP regions.
records.source_org: Nazilli Cotton Research Institute (Pamuk Araştırma Enstitüsü)

records.applicationMethod: P and K applied as basal. N split at seedbed preparation and after thinning (seyleme) before row closure.
records.applicationTiming: P/K basal; N split at seedbed preparation and after thinning.
records.notes: N 130-170 kg/ha; P2O5 70-100 kg/ha; K2O 80-140 kg/ha. Sugar beet (seker pancari), Konya plain.
records.source_org: Şeker Enstitüsü (Turkish Sugar Factories Research Institute), Ankara

records.applicationMethod: 100% of dose placed as basal with the drill at sowing.
records.notes: N 15-25 kg/ha; P2O5 40-55 kg/ha; K2O 20-30 kg/ha. Chickpea (nohut).
records.source_org: TAGEM Field Crops Central Research Institute, Ankara

records.applicationMethod: 100% of dose drilled as basal with DAP at autumn sowing.
records.notes: N 15-20 kg/ha; P2O5 40-50 kg/ha; K2O 15-25 kg/ha. Red lentil (kirmizi mercimek), GAP region.

records.applicationMethod: Basal DAP at sowing. Top-dressed N split, including late application, to ensure high grain protein and vitreousness.
records.applicationTiming: Basal DAP; split top-dress N with late application for protein.
records.notes: N 90-140 kg/ha; P2O5 50-70 kg/ha; K2O 30-45 kg/ha. Durum wheat (makarnalik bugday), GAP and Central Anatolia.

records.applicationMethod: Basal P and K at sowing. Early spring top-dress of N.
records.applicationTiming: Basal P/K; early spring N top-dress.
records.notes: N 50-80 kg/ha; P2O5 35-50 kg/ha; K2O 25-35 kg/ha. Oats (yulaf).
records.source_org: TAGEM (Tarımsal Araştırmalar ve Politikalar Genel Müdürlüğü)

records.applicationMethod: Single top-dress of N at the winter-spring transition.
records.notes: N 45-70 kg/ha; P2O5 30-45 kg/ha; K2O 20-30 kg/ha. Rye (cavdar).
records.source_org: TAGEM (Tarımsal Araştırmalar ve Politikalar Genel Müdürlüğü)

records.applicationMethod: Basal banded at sowing. Seed inoculated with Rhizobium japonicum.
records.notes: N 20-30 kg/ha (starter); P2O5 50-70 kg/ha; K2O 40-60 kg/ha. Soybean (soya), Cukurova 2nd crop.
records.source_org: Doğu Akdeniz Tarımsal Araştırma Enstitüsü, Adana

records.applicationMethod: Basal at sowing. Gypsum side-dressed during early flowering / pegging stage.
records.applicationTiming: Basal at sowing; gypsum side-dress at early flowering/pegging.
records.micronutrients: Gypsum 300-500 kg/ha side-dressed at early flowering/pegging.
records.notes: N 20-30 kg/ha; P2O5 50-70 kg/ha; K2O 40-60 kg/ha. Groundnut (yer fistigi), Osmaniye/Kadirli.

records.applicationMethod: 50% N + full P and K at planting. Remaining 50% N split through drip or side-dress during tuber bulking.
records.applicationTiming: 50% N + full P/K at planting; 50% N during tuber bulking.
records.notes: N 160-220 kg/ha; P2O5 90-130 kg/ha; K2O 180-260 kg/ha. Potato (patates), Nigde/Nevsehir/Odemis.

records.applicationMethod: Basal P and K at sowing. 50% N top-dressed before flowering with irrigation.
records.applicationTiming: Basal P/K; 50% N top-dress before flowering with irrigation.
records.notes: N 35-55 kg/ha; P2O5 30-45 kg/ha; K2O 25-40 kg/ha. Sesame (susam), Mediterranean and Aegean coastal belts.
records.source_org: BATEM (Batı Akdeniz Tarımsal Araştırma Enstitüsü), Antalya
